hypothesis: A low-step continuation with averaged gradients can convert the observed training-only repair signal into a transferable improvement of the existing GBCT map.
work_policy: Matched optimizer updates, not matched row presentations, epochs, FLOPs or wall time. Small=3M and averaged=30M row presentations per fit. 50k divides both batches; fixed seeded permutations without partial batches.
changed_factor: Gradient batch size only; accumulation avoids memory-driven changes. Sizes align with the existing 50k pool and historical 10k batch.
fixed: continued GBCT initial weights per seed
exposure: 50k candidate training pool. U20k is base/preprocessing-seen but candidate-update-unseen. D1023 repeatedly inspected development. No restricted confirmation. No extra metric or calibration fitting.
selection: Final checkpoint only. Record training metrics every500 steps; no U/D data enters training or checkpoint selection.
inference: One updated GBCT network with original preprocessing and decoder; no residual head, temperature switch, clipping/projection added, or query references. Existing inverse-domain handling is unchanged and evaluated.
evaluation: Full T50k,U20k,D1023, both seeds; pinned protected evaluator and exact campaign gates against anchor/incumbent; independent raw-prediction recount, fresh base replay, whole-pipeline latency

outcomes.averaged_passes_all_gates: Record development-qualified candidate without manual incumbent replacement; continue authorized robustness work
outcomes.both_improve_but_fail_gates: Quantify each failed guard; no promotion; choose one evidence-specific follow-up
outcomes.averaged_only_beats_small: Batch support is useful in this recipe but not sufficient; distinguish fit/transfer and preservation
outcomes.neither_improves: Close this low-step continuation recipe provisionally; do not run another LR/batch sweep without new evidence
